description.la: Tractatulus dictus Hospitale pauperum: capitula de contemptu bonorum mundanorum, de paupertate spiritus, de patientia et de consolatione pauperum Christi.
description.en-US: A treatise for the poor of Christ: contempt of worldly goods, poverty of spirit, patience and the comfort of the poor, drawn chiefly from the Psalms. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Tratado para os pobres de Cristo: desprezo dos bens do mundo, pobreza de espírito, paciência e consolação, tirado sobretudo dos Salmos.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Hospitale pauperum, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR (Pohl 1918 volume).
sources.description: Chapters as Pohl divides them, with his upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings and isolated letters are often garbled; a chapter heading lost to OCR runs two chapters together.
